description: This PHP source file defines a class 'HomeViewAdditionaldetailsretrieve' that extends SugarView. It handles AJAX requests to retrieve and display additional details for a specific CRM module and record, dynamically including module-specific metadata and functions, performing access checks, and returning formatted JSON response.

classes.name: HomeViewAdditionaldetailsretrieve
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to handle AJAX calls for retrieving additional details of CRM records, dynamically loading module metadata, and rendering responses.
